title: Research target resolution discards a full-query disambiguation in favour of a one-word prefix bind, so an ambiguous full company name can bind a different company via a narrower query
repro: services/research/target.resolve_target: attempt 1 'KPIT Technologies' -> non-curated disambiguation (KPITTECH, BSOFT) is only remembered; attempt 'KPIT' (1-word prefix) binds BSOFT via the retired-ticker lane at confidence 1.0 >= the one-word minimum and is returned. The chooser the user should have seen is dropped. The KPIT instance is fixed at the resolver in fix-r1 W3; this ladder behaviour remains for any other full-name tie.
